title: Frontend verification and deployment error resolution

requirements.summary: Investigate deployment error by reviewing frontend build configuration, actor integration, and authentication setup to identify any frontend-side issues contributing to deployment failure
acceptanceCriteria: The specific deployment error message and stack trace are identified
The root cause of the deployment failure is determined (e.g., Motoko compilation error, canister memory limit, network issue, configuration problem)
A clear diagnosis is provided explaining why the deployment failed

file_operations.description: Review the actor initialization and access control setup to ensure it properly handles deployment scenarios and backend interface changes. Verify that error handling is robust and that the actor creation does not cause initialization failures during deployment.

Verify the authentication flow and profile setup logic to ensure no frontend initialization issues could block deployment. Check that loading states and error boundaries properly handle deployment scenarios where the backend might be temporarily unavailable.

requirements.summary: Apply frontend fixes to resolve identified deployment issues, ensuring frontend builds successfully and properly integrates with the corrected backend
acceptanceCriteria: The code changes or configuration adjustments that caused the deployment error are corrected
The backend compiles successfully without errors
The frontend builds successfully without errors
The application can be deployed to the Internet Computer network without errors

file_operations.description: Update backend interface type definitions if the deployment error is related to backend interface changes or type mismatches. Ensure all frontend code using backend methods has correct type signatures matching the deployed backend.

Review and fix any React Query hooks that might be calling backend methods incorrectly or with mismatched types. Ensure all backend method calls use the correct signatures and handle errors gracefully during deployment scenarios.

Verify that profile setup properly handles authorization component requirements and does not cause initialization failures. Ensure the modal correctly uses the authorization system's getCallerUserProfile and saveCallerUserProfile methods as required by the authorization component.

requirements.summary: Verify frontend functionality remains intact after deployment fix, ensuring all user-facing features work correctly and no regressions were introduced
acceptanceCriteria: The deployment completes successfully without errors
The canister is accessible and responsive after deployment
All existing features (user authentication, harvest listings, commitments, transport offers, buyer demands, crop diagnosis) remain functional
No regressions are introduced by the deployment fix

file_operations.description: Verify that the farmer dashboard loads correctly after deployment and all harvest listing operations (create, view, delete) work as expected. Ensure crop diagnosis and predictive analytics features remain functional.

Verify that the buyer dashboard loads correctly after deployment and all buyer operations (browse listings, make commitments, post demands) work as expected. Ensure filtering and commitment tracking features remain functional.
Verify that the transporter dashboard loads correctly after deployment and transport opportunity features work as expected. Ensure route optimization and transport offer creation remain functional.

Verify that Internet Identity authentication works correctly after deployment, including login, logout, and query cache clearing. Ensure the authorization component integration functions properly with no authentication regressions.
